attribution.modifications: Original texture-free flat-colour geometry on the 3DBAG LoD2.2 shell (CC BY 4.0) of BAG pand 0363100012240693 (CC0): the glazed north-east gable between timber posts with the name on its beam, the rust-red rake boards, the south-east side's three round portholes under the dark fascia, the south-west gable's timber frame, round gable window and mural (as flat colour panels), and the red tile roof with three roof lights, read from Gemeente Amsterdam panoramas (CC BY 4.0) and the PDOK orthophoto.
